canvas{max-height:280px;}
.panel-fill{display:flex;flex-direction:column;}
/* Fixed (not flex:1/min-height-only) so the container's height can never depend on the canvas's own
   size - Chart.js's responsive resize reads the container's height via ResizeObserver, and if that
   height is itself derived from the canvas (flex-grow inside a CSS Grid row with no explicit row
   height, as this was), each resize nudges the container taller, which nudges the canvas taller,
   which nudges the container taller again - an unbounded growth loop with no natural stopping point.
   A fixed height matching the same 280px every other chart on this page already settles to (via the
   canvas{max-height:280px} rule above) removes the ambiguity entirely while keeping this panel the
   same visual height as its row siblings. */
.chart-fill-wrap{position:relative;height:280px;}
.chart-fill-wrap canvas{max-height:none!important;height:100%!important;width:100%!important;}
/* Per instruction ("expands to the maximum size relative to the webpage dimensions... the map
   should overlay and hover directly over the page content itself... scale dynamically to the full
   available page size"): the map is a full-viewport overlay (fixed, covering the whole page) rather
   than an inline card in the page flow - opened/closed via the sidebar's "Interactive Map" toggle. */
.map-panel{
  position:fixed; inset:0; z-index:2000;
  background:rgba(11,42,74,.6);
  display:flex; padding:22px;
}
.map-overlay-inner{
  background:var(--card); border-radius:12px; padding:16px 18px;
  flex:1; min-height:0; min-width:0; display:flex; flex-direction:column;
  box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.4); position:relative;
}
.map-panel .desc{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:10px;padding-right:36px;}
.map-panel h3{padding-right:36px;}
.map-close-btn{
  position:absolute; top:14px; right:14px; z-index:1;
  width:32px; height:32px; border-radius:50%; border:none;
  background:var(--navy); color:#fff; font-size:18px; line-height:1; cursor:pointer;
  display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
}
.map-close-btn:hover{background:var(--red);}
.map-legend{display:flex;gap:14px;margin-bottom:10px;font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);flex-wrap:wrap;}
.map-legend span{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;}
.map-legend i{display:inline-block;width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:3px;}

/* Developer watermark: lives in the sidebar, below the module button list (#sidebarNav) - so it
   sits outside/below every module (including PICT, the last item in the list) rather than inside
   the scrolling main content, and stays in the same place regardless of which page/module is active.
   Content (app name, version, developer, last-update date) is populated at runtime by
   renderDevWatermark() from NTP_VERSION_LOG, so it "dynamically updates" whenever a new log entry
   ships, without needing markup edits. */
